response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile software engineer with nearly two decades of hands-on development across web, mobile, embedded, and infrastructure domains, but his profile does not match the strategic, director-level AI leadership focus of this role. His AI exposure is limited to a few months of MCP/agentic tooling work, he has no track record of advising strategic customers on cloud/AI adoption, and his career trajectory reflects individual contributor engineering roles rather than technical strategy or thought leadership at scale.
strengths: 19+ years of broad, hands-on software engineering experience across many stacks and platforms
Demonstrated ability to teach, mentor, and speak publicly (workshops, conference talks, courses)
Recent exposure to AI-agent infrastructure and MCP code-generation tooling
concerns: No evidence of director-level strategic leadership, technical vision-setting, or advising external strategic customers/partners
AI experience is minimal and recent (since April 2025), falling well short of 'recognized AI expertise with demonstrated products/platforms'
No advanced degree in an AI-related field and no clear entrepreneurial/startup experience within a larger organization
